overview: This file traces postwar efforts to restore and protect foreign intellectual property rights in Japan. Correspondence, policy drafts, occupation directives, and case reports cover trademarks, trade names, patents, copyrights, textile designs, and export origin markings from 1945 to 1949.
interest: Drafts and directives show how occupation policy became enforceable rules, alongside detailed disputes involving American and British firms.
